statements.status_notes: The vulnerability affects all versions of Apache Spark with no fix currently available. DHI Spark images are typically deployed in authenticated cluster environments or used in contexts where the standalone resource manager's master-worker architecture is not directly exposed to untrusted input, significantly reducing the attack surface. Additionally the DHI spark image is having the authentication enabled by default, meaning that the vulnerability can only be exploited if the user explicitly disables spark.authentication while running in standalone mode.
